title: お正月の飾り 和風
subject_en: New Year objects, each one a separate item (no characters)
lead: 門松、鏡もち、初日の出、鶴と亀、松竹梅、羽子板、凧、おせち、だるま、破魔矢まで。お正月の定番モチーフを、和風のタッチで18点そろえました。年賀状の飾りに。
items: kadomatsu: bamboo stalks cut diagonally with pine branches and a red-white rope
kagami-mochi: two stacked round rice cakes, a bitter orange (daidai) with leaf on top, on a folded-paper stand
a large rising sun with rays behind a stylised Mt. Fuji with a snow cap and a few pine silhouettes
an elegant white crane with a red crown, wings spread
a cute auspicious turtle with a hexagon-pattern shell and a small seaweed tail
pine, bamboo and plum blossoms arranged together as one auspicious bundle
a decorative hagoita paddle with a plain pretty design of a plum blossom and a shuttlecock
a simple rectangular Japanese kite with a tail and a plain bold design
a three-tier osechi lacquer box with the top tier open showing colourful dishes
a red daruma doll with one white eye and a gold brush-stroke pattern
a hamaya arrow with feathers and a small bell and red-white ribbon
an ema wooden plaque in a house shape with a plain horse-less pattern of plum blossoms (blank)
a lion-dance (shishimai) head with red face, gold teeth and a green cloth body, friendly not scary
a pine branch with an open folding fan beside it
a branch of red nanten berries with green leaves
a small decorative red envelope (pochibukuro) with a plum pattern and a knot of gold-red string (blank, no text)
a gold-and-red mizuhiki knot decoration in a plum-flower shape
a bowl of toshikoshi soba with fried tofu, green onion and a kamaboko slice, steam rising
